title: Musical Instruments Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=forscore:practice) OR (index=personal sourcetype=yousician:lesson)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="forscore:practice","primary",sourcetype="yousician:lesson","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from forscore:practice and yousician:lesson to see whether two musical instruments feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `forscore:practice` and `yousician:lesson` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main musical instruments data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
